policy.termsDescription: These terms govern the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between Feel&Note and its members.
policy.privacyDescription: Feel&Note values your personal information and complies with applicable privacy laws.
policy.koreanOnly: This document is currently available in Korean only.
policy.terms1Body: These Terms govern the conditions and procedures for using the cultural life recording and sharing platform service ("Service") provided by Feel&Note ("Company"), and the rights, duties, and responsibilities of the Company and its members.
policy.terms2Item1: "Service" refers to Feel&Note and all related services accessible by members regardless of device (PC, mobile, etc.).
policy.terms2Item2: "Member" refers to a customer who has agreed to these Terms and entered into a service agreement with the Company.
policy.terms2Item3: "Content" refers to text, photos, videos, files, links, and other information in the form of signs, characters, audio, video, etc. posted by members on the Service.
policy.terms3Body:
1. Users may apply for membership by filling in the registration form or through social login (Google, Kakao, etc.).
2. The Company shall, in principle, accept the user's application. However, the Company may reject or later terminate the agreement if the applicant used a false identity or another person's information.
policy.terms4Intro: Members shall not engage in any of the following acts:
policy.terms4Item1: Registering false information during application or modification
policy.terms4Item3: Altering information posted by the Company
policy.terms4Item4: Infringing on the copyrights or other intellectual property rights of the Company or third parties
policy.terms4Item5: Damaging the reputation of or interfering with the business of the Company or third parties
policy.terms4Item6: Publicly posting obscene or violent messages, images, audio, or other information contrary to public morals
policy.terms5Body:
1. The copyright of posts made by members within the Service belongs to the author of each post.
2. Members shall not reproduce, transmit, publish, distribute, broadcast, or otherwise use information obtained through the Service for commercial purposes without the Company's prior consent.
3. The Company may use content posted by members for the purpose of operating, promoting, and improving the Service.
policy.terms6Body: The Company is exempt from responsibility for service provision in cases of force majeure such as natural disasters. The Company is not liable for any expected profits lost by members through use of the Service, nor for damages arising from materials obtained through the Service.
policy.termsEffectiveDate: These Terms are effective from January 11, 2026.
policy.privacy1Body: The Company processes personal information for the following purposes. Personal information being processed will not be used for purposes other than the following, and necessary measures such as obtaining separate consent will be taken if the purpose changes.
policy.privacy1Item1: Membership registration and management: Providing membership services, personal identification, confirming intent to register, screening and usage restrictions, etc.
policy.privacy1Item2: Service provision and improvement: Storing cultural life records, personalized content recommendations, service feature improvements, etc.
policy.privacy1Item3: Customer inquiry handling: Verifying identity, confirming inquiries, contacting for fact-finding, notifying of results, etc.
policy.privacy2Body: The Company may collect the following personal information during registration and use of the Service.
policy.privacy2Item1: Required: Email address, nickname, profile image (information provided through social login)
policy.privacy2Item2: Optional: User's cultural content records (movies, books, performances, etc.), self-introduction, etc.
policy.privacy2Item3: Automatically collected: IP address, cookies, access logs, service usage records, device information
policy.privacy3Title: 3. Retention and Use Period of Personal Information
policy.privacy3Body: The Company processes and retains personal information within the retention and use period prescribed by law or agreed upon at the time of collection.
policy.privacy3Item1: Upon membership withdrawal: Destroyed without delay (except where prohibited by relevant laws)
policy.privacy3Item2: Retention under relevant laws: Where retention is required by provisions of relevant laws such as the Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce
policy.privacy4Body: The Company destroys personal information without delay when it becomes unnecessary due to expiration of the retention period or achievement of the processing purpose. Electronic files are deleted using technical methods to prevent recovery.
policy.privacy5Title: 5. Member Rights and How to Exercise Them
policy.privacy5Body: Members may exercise their rights to access, correct, delete, or suspend processing of their personal information at any time. Such rights may be exercised through written notice, email, etc. to the Company, and the Company will act without delay.
policy.privacy6Body: This Service displays third-party advertisements to cover operating costs and maintain free access. Cookies and similar technologies are used in this process.
policy.privacy6Item1: Google AdSense: This Service displays advertisements through Google AdSense. Google and third-party ad networks may use cookies (including the DART cookie) to serve personalized ads based on your interests.
policy.privacy6Item2: Google Analytics: This Service uses Google Analytics to analyze website usage. Google Analytics collects anonymous statistical data through cookies, and the collected data is used solely for service improvement purposes.
policy.privacy6Item3: Cookie management and ad personalization opt-out: You can refuse or delete cookies through your browser settings. You can also disable personalized ads through Google Ads Settings (https://adssettings.google.com) or opt out of third-party ad cookies through the Network Advertising Initiative (https://optout.networkadvertising.org). Some service features may be limited if you refuse cookies.
policy.privacy7Body: The following Privacy Officer is designated to oversee personal information processing and to handle member complaints and damage relief related to personal information processing.
policy.contactDescription: Get in touch with Feel&Note for inquiries and feedback.
policy.contactEmailDesc: If you have any questions, please reach out to us via email.
policy.contactFeedbackDesc: For feature suggestions, bug reports, or other feedback, please use our feedback board.
policy.aboutDescription: Feel&Note is an archive of the books read and the cultural works enjoyed by historical figures and contemporary notables, researched and compiled by our editorial team.
policy.aboutWhatBody1: Feel&Note is an archive that researches and compiles the reading records of historical figures and contemporary notables, along with their impressions of films, music, games, and other cultural works. We gather material on more than 1,000 people and organize it by individual, so you can see in one place which books someone read and what led them to each one.
policy.aboutWhatBody2: Beyond browsing these records, you can also keep your own: log the books you have read and the works you have experienced, and build a personal history of your impressions over time.
policy.aboutContentBody: Every reading list and every account of how someone came to a book is researched and written by our editorial team. We work from publicly available sources such as interviews, biographies, memoirs, and recorded talks, and we do not publish claims we cannot verify.
policy.aboutContentItem1: We search published material, including interviews, biographies, memoirs, public lectures, and press coverage, for the books and works a person has mentioned.
policy.aboutContentItem2: We check what we find against the original material, then our editorial team writes up how the person encountered the work and what they said about it.
policy.aboutContentItem3: Each entry cites the source it draws on, so you can go back to the original material and check it yourself.
policy.aboutOperatorBody: Feel&Note is operated by the Feel&Note team, based in the Republic of Korea. For questions about the service, corrections to our records, or partnership inquiries, please write to us at the address below or use our contact page.
policy.aboutActivityBody: Our editorial team also turns the reading stories collected in this archive into videos, published on our YouTube channel. You can browse the related videos here on the site as well.
